senses.gloss:
तोक तोक, अम्, n. (connected with 1. तुच् and
1. तुज्, and said by some to be fr. rt. 2. तु), offspring,
children, race, male or female offspring, a child,
(in the Ṛg-veda तोक is never used in pl.; it is
often joined with तनय); a new-born child; the
offspring of any animal (in comp., e. g. वराह-
तोक, a young boar); [cf. त्वक्ष्, स्तोक, तक्ष्; Gr.
τέκνον, τίκτω, ἔτεκον, τοκάς; Angl. Sax. thegn,
thegen; Old Germ. degan, ‘servant.’]
—तोक-वत्,
आन्, अती, अत्, Ved. connected with offspring, having
children.
—तोक-साति, इस्, f., Ved. the acquisition of
offspring.

तोक्म, अस्, m. and (in the earlier language) तोक्-
मन्, अ, n. a young green blade of corn, especially
of barley, green or unripe barley; (अस्), m. green
colour; (अम्), n. the wax of the ear; a cloud.

तोकाय, Nom. P. तोकायति, to be like a new-born
child.
